cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total de comprobantes emitidos en enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.total_amount), 0) AS total FROM sales_invoice si WHERE si.status = 'Issued' AND si.issued_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND si.issued_at < DATE '2026-02-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.total_amount), 0) AS total_comprobantes FROM public.sales_invoice AS si WHERE si.issued_at >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND si.issued_at <= CAST('2026-01-31' AS DATE) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se facturó por cada tipo de comprobante en enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT si.voucher_type, SUM(si.total_amount) AS total FROM sales_invoice si WHERE si.status = 'Issued' AND si.issued_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND si.issued_at < DATE '2026-02-01' GROUP BY si.voucher_type ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT si.voucher_type AS tipo_comprobante, SUM(si.total_amount) AS total_facturado FROM public.sales_invoice AS si WHERE si.issued_at >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND si.issued_at < CAST('2026-02-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY si.voucher_type LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se cobró por cada medio de pago en enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT pt.name AS medio, SUM(sp.amount) AS total FROM sales_payment sp JOIN payment_type pt ON pt.id = sp.payment_type_id WHERE sp.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND sp.paid_at < DATE '2026-02-01' GROUP BY pt.id, pt.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pt.name AS medio_pago, COALESCE(SUM(sp.amount), 0) AS total_cobrado FROM public.sales_payment AS sp JOIN public.payment_type AS pt ON sp.payment_type_id = pt.id WHERE sp.paid_at >= CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND sp.paid_at < CAST('2026-02-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY pt.name ORDER BY total_cobrado DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántos pedidos cerrados para llevar hubo en enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM sales_order so WHERE so.order_type = 'Llevar' AND so.status = 'Closed' AND so.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND so.ordered_at < DATE '2026-02-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_pedidos_cerrados FROM public.sales_order AS so WHERE so.status ILIKE '%closed%' AND so.order_type ILIKE '%para llevar%' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM so.ordered_at) = 2026 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM so.ordered_at) = 1 LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué productos vendieron más unidades en pedidos cerrados durante enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS unidades FROM sales_order so JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = so.id JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND p.sellable = TRUE AND so.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND so.ordered_at < DATE '2026-02-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY unidades DESC LIMIT 5
cases.generated_sql: SELECT p.id AS id, p.name AS name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM public.product AS p JOIN public.order_item AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN public.sales_order AS so ON so.id = oi.order_id WHERE so.status ILIKE '%closed%' AND DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', so.ordered_at) = CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total vendido por canal de pedido en enero de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT so.order_type, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total FROM sales_order so JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = so.id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND so.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND so.ordered_at < DATE '2026-02-01' GROUP BY so.order_type ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT so.order_type AS canal_pedido, COALESCE(SUM(si.total_amount), 0) AS total_vendido FROM public.sales_order AS so JOIN public.sales_invoice AS si ON si.order_id = so.id WHERE si.issued_at >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND si.issued_at <= CAST('2026-01-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY so.order_type LIMIT 50
